NAME: Aqueous Form
DESC: Looking inside, this liquid appears to be ocean water but smells like water lilies and sea salt.
DETAILS: This liquid transforms the target into a pool of water. They return to their true form after 10 minutes or if they are incapacitated or killed.

NAME: True Form
DESC: It is a watery, orange liquid that smells like oak wood.
DETAILS: This liquid transforms a shape-shifted created back into their natural form.

NAME: Parent Trap
DESC: This is a thick, milky white liquid. It smells salty and sweet.
DETAILS: The liquid makes the target care for children for a full day. They cannot deny requests made by children. They have a +10 CHA bonus to parents and fertility is increased to 60% if both partners are capable of reproduction.

NAME: Cure-All
DESC: This liquid is crimson in color and three purple lily petals float in the liquid. It smells like almonds.
DETAILS: The liquid cures the target of any conditions and diseases, but does nothing for curses.
